# Roll your own iBot

Go one step at a time. Confirm each step worked before the next. Plain words, no jargon dumps.

## Hard rules
- NEVER ask the owner to paste the .p8 contents, or any private key, into chat. They paste it straight into Vercel's env var UI (Project > Settings > Environment Variables, marked Sensitive) or into a masked secret form. If they paste it into chat anyway, tell them to revoke that key in the Apple Developer portal and make a new one.
- Never commit a .p8, .env file, or the .vercel/ folder. The repo's .gitignore already excludes them.
- Team ID and Key ID aren't secret, but don't repeat them back where you don't need to.

## Steps
1. **Apple Developer account.** They need a paid Apple Developer Program membership (developer.apple.com/account).
2. **MusicKit identifier.** Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles > Identifiers > + > Media IDs. Enable MusicKit.
3. **MusicKit key.** Keys > + . Name it, tick MusicKit, configure it with the Media ID, then Continue > Register > Download. The .p8 downloads only once, so they should store it safely.
4. **Note the IDs.** Key ID is on the key's page. Team ID is under Membership details. Both are 10 characters.
5. **Fork + deploy.** Open github.com/PhillipHolland/ibot and click "Deploy with Vercel" (or fork and import it at vercel.com/new). Pick a project name; the URL will be <name>.vercel.app.
6. **Four env vars:**
   - APPLE_TEAM_ID: the Team ID
   - APPLE_KEY_ID: the Key ID
   - APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY: the whole .p8 file contents including the BEGIN/END lines, pasted directly into Vercel and marked Sensitive
   - ALLOWED_ORIGINS: the BARE host, e.g. `ibot-sam.vercel.app`. No https://, no slash, no path. Separate several hosts with commas, e.g. a custom domain.
   Redeploy after changing any env var.
7. **Check the token.** Open https://<host>/api/token in a browser on the deployed site. A JSON `token` means the token service works. A "not configured" error means a variable is missing or the key is malformed.
8. **Test on iPhone.** Open the site in Safari. With Sign In selected, press the center button and finish Apple's sign-in. Play a song. Then Share > Add to Home Screen.

## Common failures
- **Sign-in fails / /api/token returns 403 "Origin not allowed".** ALLOWED_ORIGINS includes https://, a trailing slash, or the wrong host (preview URLs differ from production). Fix it to the bare host and redeploy.
- **Scripts blocked (CSP errors in the console).** They added a domain or script that vercel.json's Content-Security-Policy doesn't allow. Leave the CSP alone unless they changed the app, then add only what's needed.
- **Apple returns 401/403, or the token is rejected.** Wrong Team ID or Key ID, key not enabled for MusicKit, key revoked, or APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY truncated (missing BEGIN/END lines). Re-check the IDs against the portal and have them re-paste the key in Vercel themselves.
- **500 "Token service is not configured".** One of the three APPLE_* vars is missing or the key won't parse.
- **"Needs Apple Music subscription".** The Apple ID has no active Apple Music subscription.
- **One song won't play.** That catalog item isn't available in their Apple Music storefront (country). Try another track; it isn't a setup bug.

## Done when
They've signed in on their own deployment, played a song, and added it to the home screen.

description: "Use on the first conversation after someone imports the \U0001F3BC iBot Player template: say what iBot is, check prerequisites, then start ibot-setup."

# 🎼 iBot Player: first conversation

1. Say in two lines what you do: "I'll help you set up your own iBot, an iPod-style player for your Apple Music (like ibotplayer.vercel.app), on your own Vercel account. Takes about 15 minutes."
2. Ask, one at a time:
   - Do you have a paid Apple Developer account? (If not, they need one first; point them to developer.apple.com/programs.)
   - Do you have GitHub and Vercel accounts?
   - Do you have an Apple Music subscription and an iPhone with Safari to test on?
   - What would you like your site called? (This becomes <name>.vercel.app.)
3. Save their answers (project name, host, what's done) to memory so later turns can pick up where they left off.
4. Say the one rule up front: "Never paste your .p8 key in chat. When we get there, you'll paste it straight into Vercel."
5. Load the ibot-setup skill and start at the first step they haven't done.
6. End when they've played a song on their iBot from their home screen. Offer help with a custom domain (it goes in ALLOWED_ORIGINS too).
